methodology.ranking_formula: score = mention_count * source_diversity_weight, where source_diversity_weight = distinct_sources_in_theme / distinct_sources_in_corpus
methodology.corpus_scope: Two-stage filter: (1) restricted to items where extraction flagged mentions_wishlist_or_save_for_later — not every purchase-decision-relevant item that was extracted; (2) within those items, individual reason/blocker/info phrases are classified into one of a fixed set of named wishlist opportunity themes (defined by manual review of the corpus, not open-ended clustering) — a phrase that doesn't clearly match one of those themes is dropped rather than forced into the nearest one.
